{{Quote|A rather notorious member of this humanoid species is one Nik Hepho, a bounty hunter who specializes in hunting down those suspected of following the outlawed religion known as the Church of the Force. With unmistakable smooth blue skin, he is not an easy character to miss.|An entry in an artist's journal restored and expanded by the Graf Archive|<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref>}}
'''Nik Hepho''' was a [[Britarro]] who worked as a [[bounty hunter]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He specialized in hunting members of the outlawed [[Church of the Force]] and, after working in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] and on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], traveled to the [[moon]] [[Jedha]] to hunt down more suspected adherents. 

He at one point traveled to an area of [[desert]] and made it unsafe to travel through until an [[Unidentified Imperial spy (Jedha)|Imperial spy]] snuck up on the increasingly reckless bounty hunter and disarmed him before letting him flee. Hepho was later present in [[Jedha City]] shortly before it was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION. On Jedha to stop Church of the Force members.|An Imperial dossier on Hepho|<ref name="Unlocked">''[[Unlock!: Star Wars Escape Game]]''</ref>}}
[[File:NikHephoDossier-Unlock.png|thumb|right|300px|The Empire maintained a dossier on Hepho.]]
The [[Britarro]] Nik Hepho worked as a [[bounty hunter]], specializing in tracking down adherents of the [[Church of the Force]], a religion outlawed by the [[Galactic Empire]]. His skill gained him some renown in the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]], and he [[Hunting|hunted]] in the depths of the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] until he considered that area empty of targets. Hepho then traveled to the [[moon]] of [[Jedha]] with a list of suspected Church members compiled by the [[Imperial Security Bureau]] that he had bought on the [[black market]]. While on Jedha, Hepho kept his [[starship]], the ''[[Apostate]]'', hovering in [[orbit]] under the control of a [[Droid brain|droid intelligence]] with which he maintained contact via a [[backpack]]-mounted long-range [[transmitter]].<ref name="ROUVG" />

Hepho at one point traveled around mounted in the Jedha [[desert]] in the area between the [[Toribota Temple]] and the [[Pilgrim Market]], eventually hiding within the shadows of an outcropping from which he monitored the surronding area and prevented anyone from passing through safely. After Hepho shot at them from the south-west, an [[Unidentified Imperial spy (Jedha)|Imperial spy]] that needed to pass through the area near Hepho used an Imperial dossier on the Britarro to identify his mounted tracks and followed them. Having heard a [[Twi'lek]] and a [[Devaronian]] at [[Gesh's Tapcafe]] discussing how sneaking up behind Hepho was the best way to defeat him, the [[spy]] was able to surprise the bounty hunter and acted quickly to disarm him before letting him flee, allowing the spy to move through the area safely.<ref name="Unlocked" />

[[File:Nik_Hepho_Rogue_One.png|thumb|left|300px|Nik Hepho (background) in Jedha City]]
In [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' to [[1 BBY]].</ref> he walked past<ref name="RO">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> the [[Disciples of the Whills|Disciple of the Whills]] [[Silvanie Phest]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> and one of<ref name="RO" /> her<ref name="ROUVG" /> fellow disciples in the market stall-lined streets of<ref name="RO" /> [[Jedha City]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> Soon after this, the entire [[city]] was [[Destruction of Jedha City|destroyed]] by the [[superlaser]] of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]].<ref name="RO" /> Hepho was mentioned present tense and depicted in an [[Unidentified artist|artist's]] [[Unidentified artist's journal|journal]], which was restored, expanded, and displayed by the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /> at some point no earlier than [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Nik Hepho is increasingly reckless. When you'll find him, follow him. The best way to defeat him is to defeat him is to sneak up on him from behind.|A customer at Gesh's Tapcafe|<ref name="Unlocked" />}}
A Britarro, Nik Hepho had smooth, [[Color|blue]] skin and green [[eye]]s with no [[hair]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> Hepho's unmistakable skin tone made him hard to miss.<ref name="Alien Archive" /> The hunter's increasing recklessness on Jedha left him vulnerable to stealthy opponents.<ref name="Unlocked" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Excellent desert hunter and tracker. Expert sniper. Uses a heavy weapon carried ''over the shoulder''. Very dangerous.|An Imperial dossier on Hepho|<ref name="Unlocked" />}}
[[File:NikHepho-Unlock.png|thumb|right|300px|Nik Hepho was an expert sniper.]]
Nik Hepho was highly skilled at hunting and tracking in desert environments and was an expert [[sniper]]. He was considered notorious and extremely dangerous by the Empire, which advised its operatives to exercise extreme caution around the Britarro.<ref name="Unlocked" />

==Equipment==
While on Jedha, Hepho wore a yellow [[Clothing|coat]] and [[glove]]s with a gray shirt and brown pants, and made use of a metallic headpiece and a [[BlasTech Industries|BlasTech]] [[A310 rifle]] with a perforated, air-cooling [[barrel-shroud]]. He wore a backpack-mounted long-range transmitter that allowed him to keep in contact with his starship, the ''Apostate''.<ref name="ROUVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nik Hepho first appeared in the [[2016]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|''Anthology'']] film, ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. The film did not identify Hepho,<ref name="RO" /> but his name was provided by ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="ROUVG" /> and released on the same day as the film.<ref name="Book Date">{{SW|url=news/rebel-reading-rogue-one-books|text=Rebel Reading: A Guide to ''Rogue One'' Books}}</ref>
